R.Govindaraj vs The Commissioner on 4 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89748242/
1  * **
 ORDER Heard both sides. 
2. The petitioner is running a petty shop which was sealed by the second respondent on 24.01.2024. 
The petitioner has been charged with vending banned tobacco products. Since the shop has been kept under lock and seal for more than 30 days, I am inclined to grant relief. If the petitioner pays the compounding fee, he can avoid prosecution. Otherwise he has to face prosecution. I am not interfering with the impugned order. I am only directing the second respondent to de-seal the premises immediately and without any delay. This writ petition stands allowed to this extent. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
